recommendations.name: Fernando Lorendeau
recommendations.title: Corporate and M&A Counsel at EY Law - Avocat à la Cour
recommendations.text:
I had the privilege of working with Guy Benzéno as a public speaking coach, and I can say without hesitation that he is truly the best of the best. Guy brings an exceptional level of expertise, insight, and precision to every session, and his guidance delivers immediate, high‑value impact.

Thanks to his coaching, I made remarkable progress across multiple dimensions of communication: structure, clarity, presence, audience engagement, and overall delivery. Guy has a unique ability to identify exactly what needs to be improved and to offer practical, transformative tools that elevate your performance far beyond what you thought possible.

Beyond his technical mastery, Guy is an outstanding listener and an incredibly supportive coach. He creates an environment where you feel encouraged, challenged, and empowered to grow. If you are looking to take your public speaking skills to the next level, whether for high‑stakes presentations, leadership communication, or personal development, Guy is without a doubt the coach you want by your side.

I highly recommend Guy to anyone looking to elevate their public speaking with impact, humor, and effectiveness. I look forward to working with him again!

recommendations.text:
I had the wonderful opportunity to work with Guy while preparing for an 8-minute speech in front of more than 1,000 people. From the very beginning, he pushed my thinking in the best possible way — challenging me to go deeper, while always staying true to my own voice and style.

What impressed me most was how well Guy tunes into personal authenticity. He doesn't just bring great ideas — he makes sure they reflect you and your story. He has a rare ability to take something complex or unclear and turn it into something simple, genuine, and impactful for the audience.

And he does all of this with incredible style and a great sense of humor, making even the toughest parts of the process feel easy and enjoyable. Working with Guy was both inspiring and fun, and I'm looking forward to partnering with him again in the future.

What impressed me most is how down to earth and authentic he is. He has a unique ability to make complex things simple, yet impactful. Beyond the techniques, he helped me build confidence in myself, always offering support and constructive feedback that pushed me to improve.

Thank you, Guy — I truly appreciated your guidance, and I'd love to collaborate again in the future!

I highly recommend him to anyone looking to elevate their speaking skills with energy, fun and authenticity.

recommendations.title: Product owner at Finologee
recommendations.text:
I recently attended a workshop on persuasion, which was structured around seven key points from a famous book that I had attempted to read multiple times but struggled to finish. In just three hours, the workshop covered all the essential insights with real-life examples, and even addressed every question from the audience.

Some concepts were not easy to grasp at first, but the presenter used engaging examples—including references from movies—to make them more accessible.

For me, this experience was a double bonus: not only did I gain valuable knowledge on persuasion, but I also got to observe a great presenter in action—learning how to start a speech, keep an audience engaged, and ensure that key takeaways truly stick.

recommendations.name: Aaron Turner
recommendations.title: 3 Decade Cybersecurity Veteran | IANS Faculty | Luxembourg Startup World Cup Winner
recommendations.text:
I met Guy as the result of the startup communication coaching session that the Luxembourg House of Startups conducted in February 2020. What I appreciated about Guy's approach is the way that he has consolidated communications best practices from many different sources and fused them into one-page overviews which are immediately useful to anyone trying to communicate complex ideas.

Our company retained Guy on a 1:1 basis after that initial session and we worked together over the course of a week to take a very complex concept (our cyber security technology portfolio) and distill the essential elements down to a 4-minute presentation for the Startup World Cup competition hosted by Ernst & Young.

We were selected as the Luxembourg representative to the International Startup World Cup, and I would attribute our win to the time that we spent with Guy. Getting direct feedback from someone not involved in cyber security was really helpful — he kept it simple for a non-expert to understand the potential of our technology. I would highly recommend Guy's services to anyone who wishes to improve their communication style, presentation skills and public speaking abilities.
